evidence_tier: executed differential (tier 1), against the OpenMS4 Release C++ build
method: An oracle driver links the pinned, header-only MorphologicalFilter out of the OpenMS4 Release build and runs every case in a forked child, so the source's process-wide static buffers in filterRange/applyErosion_/applyDilation_ start empty as in a fresh TOPP process; an experiment group runs its spectra through one filterExperiment call in one child, so the history those buffers carry between spectra is observed. The Release BaselineFilter tool itself was run on the same mzML inputs. Intensities are printed with %.9g, which round-trips binary32, and m/z with %.17g.
